description: percent = round_half_up(|actual - declared| / declared * 100, 2), displayed as "N.NN". actRequired = |actual - declared| * 100 > 2 * declared, computed exactly in grams (integers) so the exact-grams check does not depend on the rounded display percent. declaredKg "0.000" is rejected as { error: "DECLARED_ZERO" } instead of dividing by zero (R22).

cases.name: exactly at 2% threshold - not required (equality does not exceed)
just above 2% threshold by 1 gram - required, display percent still rounds to 2.00
actual mass zero (total loss) - percent 100%, required
actual equals declared - zero discrepancy, not required
actual greater than declared (surplus) exceeds threshold
actual less than declared (shortage) within threshold
actual less than declared, shortage exceeds threshold
small mass values - fraction rounds up at the third decimal (0.1666... -> 0.17)
rounding half-up at an exact .xx5 boundary (0.125 -> 0.13)
discrepancy just under the exact-grams threshold rounds the display percent up to 2.00 but does not require an act
minimal declared mass (1 gram) doubled - percent 100%, required
declared mass is zero - DECLARED_ZERO error, no division by zero (R22)
